diagnostics.message: :module.cur_per_service: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_service is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:module.cur_per_resource_process: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_resource_process is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:module.cur_per_resource: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_resource is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.cur_per_resource has `depends_on = [aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_resource]`, but the same block already sets `logging_log_group = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_resource.name`, which makes the module depend on the log group implicitly. The explicit depends_on duplicates that ordering and can be removed.

module.cur_per_resource_process has `depends_on = [aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_resource_process]`, but the same block already sets `logging_log_group = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_resource_process.name`, so the dependency is already captured implicitly. The explicit depends_on is redundant.

module.cur_per_service has `depends_on = [aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_service]`, but the same block already sets `logging_log_group = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_service.name`, which already orders the module after the log group. The explicit depends_on is redundant.

aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource only depends on the bucket itself, so it can be created before aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy. The BCM Data Exports service validates the destination bucket policy at export creation time (the policy's EnableAWSDataExportsToWriteToS3AndCheckPolicy statement grants bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com s3:PutObject/s3:GetBucketPolicy), so the export must be ordered after the bucket policy or creation fails with a bucket-policy validation error.

aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_service only depends on the bucket itself, so it can be created before aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy. AWS validates the destination bucket policy when the data export is created (the policy's EnableAWSDataExportsToWriteToS3AndCheckPolicy statement grants bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com s3:PutObject/s3:GetBucketPolicy), so this export must be ordered after the bucket policy.
